text: Así queda un galpón helado cuando prendes esta salamandra, hecha con una garrafa que alguien tiró.

visuals.v: the cast iron door of a home-made wood stove made from an old gas cylinder swinging open in a cold garage workshop, bright orange fire roaring inside the stove over burning logs
visuals.motion: the fire flickers strongly and sparks rise, the door stays open

visuals.v: frost on a window glass in winter
the glass of a workshop window in a cold shed with thick frost, the frost starting to melt and drip near the stove side
visuals.motion: a few drops of water slide down the glass

text: La escarcha del vidrio se corre sola. Y el termómetro sube, como no subía con la estufa.

visuals.v: Claudio crouching in front of a black home-made stove made from an old gas cylinder in his workshop, holding the stove door open and warming his hands, a thermometer hanging on the wall
a round dial thermometer hanging on a wooden post in a workshop showing about twenty degrees, frosty window behind it

text: Porque la estufa eléctrica del galpón, mal que mal, nunca le ganó al frío.

visuals.v: an electric two-bar heater glowing weakly on a concrete workshop floor beside a bucket, cold breath visible in the air
man rubbing cold hands near a small heater

text: Mi vecino me dijo: «Con una garrafa vas a volar por el aire.» Y tenía razón en una cosa.

visuals.v: Claudio standing in his workshop with arms crossed looking amused at a neighbour in a green cap who is shaking his head, the gas cylinder stove behind them
old rusty gas cylinder lying on the ground

text: Por eso te voy a mostrar el paso que nunca, pero nunca, hay que saltearse.

visuals.v: Claudio serious in his workshop pointing his finger toward the camera, a warning look, the stove behind him
a close view of a brass gas cylinder valve on an old cylinder with a wrench next to it on a workbench

text: Y al final, la comparación honesta: la misma habitación, el mismo termómetro y el mismo tiempo.

visuals.v: thermometer showing temperature on a wall
a wooden workbench with two thermometers placed side by side, one next to a small electric heater and the other next to a black stove, notebook beside them
two thermometers side by side

text: Mi taller es un galpón de chapa. En invierno amanece a seis, siete grados, y las manos no responden.

visuals.v: Claudio in a cold garage workshop in winter wearing a jacket over his navy work shirt, breath visible, holding a mug
cold garage workshop in winter
a cold unheated steel shed workshop with tools covered in frost at dawn, pale light coming in from the door

text: La chapa se congela de afuera, y adentro el frío te muerde los dedos de la soldadora.

visuals.v: a steel workshop shed from outside covered with frost on a winter morning, sliding door half open
frozen metal roof of a shed in winter

text: A esa temperatura el aceite se espesa, los tornillos no giran, y todo lleva el doble de tiempo.

visuals.v: a person's gloved hands holding a cold steel tube in a cold workshop, breath fogging in the air
visuals.motion: the fog of breath rises slowly and the hands tighten on the tube

visuals.v: frost on a steel vice and tools on a workbench in a cold shed

text: Y ahí, atrás del galpón, la garrafa vieja. La que se pinchó y quedó tirada tres años.

visuals.v: old gas cylinder rusty in a yard
a dented old household gas cylinder lying in the weeds behind a shed, with a rusted valve

text: Probé de todo. Calefactores eléctricos que saltaban la térmica, y una estufa a gas que se llevaba una garrafa por semana.

visuals.v: a small old electric fan heater and a gas heater with a half empty cylinder in a cold workshop corner
gas heater
electric heater in a cold room

text: Una garrafa por semana en invierno, y el galpón seguía frío. Algo no cerraba en esa cuenta.

visuals.v: Claudio counting coins on a workbench in a cold workshop with a worried face
a household gas cylinder weighed on a bathroom scale in a workshop

text: Un día la miré, miré la leña apilada, y pensé: ¿y si la garrafa fuera una estufa?

visuals.v: Claudio crouching beside an old rusty gas cylinder in his back yard, tapping it with a knuckle and looking at it thoughtfully
a pile of firewood stacked against a shed wall

text: Una estufa a leña es un tubo de chapa con puerta y chimenea. Una garrafa es exactamente eso.

visuals.v: wood burning stove in a rustic room
a classic black cast iron wood stove in a rural kitchen with a chimney pipe going up through the wall

text: El secreto de una salamandra es la superficie: una chapa grande y caliente que irradia calor para todos lados.

visuals.v: radiator heat waves above a metal stove
a drawing on a blackboard of a stove with arrows showing heat radiating from the metal surface into the room

text: Una garrafa tiene mucha chapa en poco espacio: es casi la forma ideal para calentar un galpón.

visuals.v: Claudio holding his hand near a warm metal surface feeling the radiant heat, in a workshop
an old black wood stove glowing slightly in a dim room

text: Hice un dibujo en un papel arrugado. Una garrafa acostada, una puerta, cuatro patas y una chimenea.

visuals.v: Claudio laughing and shaking his head while looking at a notebook with a sketch of a stove, in his workshop
a sheet of paper with a pencil sketch of a horizontal gas cylinder with a door, legs and a chimney pipe on a workbench

text: Antes de empezar, miré cómo lo hacen otros. Y en los comentarios, la gente repetía cuatro cosas, que anoté.

visuals.v: person reading comments on a laptop
a laptop on a workbench showing a video of a home-made rocket stove made from a gas cylinder, notebook and pencil beside it

text: Uno, que los tubos o la boca de carga estén inclinados. Dos, no quemar madera tratada. Tres, un cenicero. Cuatro, no hacerle agujeros al fondo.

visuals.v: a notebook open on a workbench with four lines written by hand, a pencil on it, workshop lights above
hand writing notes in a notebook

text: El inventario. Casi todo es chatarra, y casi todo lo tienes en el patio.

visuals.v: Claudio standing in his workshop beside the stove materials laid out on the floor, hands on hips, looking at them
old household gas cylinder lying on a concrete floor next to a stack of materials: a steel pipe, flat bars, a hinge, a sheet of steel

text: Herramientas: soldadora, amoladora, taladro, escuadra y nivel. Y protección: anteojos, guantes de cuero y careta.

visuals.v: welding helmet and gloves on a workbench
a pair of leather welding gloves, safety glasses and a welding helmet laid on a workbench

text: La garrafa, de las de diez kilos, de unos treinta centímetros de diámetro y sesenta de alto. Vacía, y pinchada.

visuals.v: an old household gas cylinder about thirty centimetres wide and sixty tall lying on a concrete floor, rusty and with a worn orange paint, valve on top
an old gas cylinder lying on a workshop floor with its valve on top
visuals.motion: a thin sunbeam moves slowly across the rusty metal

visuals.v: the valve on top of an old gas cylinder with a short steel ring guard, rust and old orange paint

text: Un caño de cuatro pulgadas para la chimenea, con un codo y un metro y medio de largo.

visuals.v: a four inch diameter steel chimney pipe with an elbow, lying on a workbench next to a tape measure
steel stove pipe

text: Planchuela y perfil ángulo para las patas y los refuerzos, de lo que sobra de cualquier portón viejo.

visuals.v: two thick steel flat bars and a piece of angle iron on a workbench, rusty at the edges
rusty steel profiles in a scrap yard

text: Dos bisagras y un pestillo. Y una chapa de dos milímetros, para el regulador de aire y el cenicero.

visuals.v: two heavy door hinges and a steel latch on a workbench, rust spots
old door hinges

text: Seis ladrillos refractarios para forrar el piso de la estufa. Los ladrillos comunes se rajan con el fuego.

visuals.v: six red fire bricks stacked beside a bucket on a workshop floor
red fire bricks

text: Una lata de pintura para altas temperaturas, que es la única que aguanta el calor de una estufa.

visuals.v: a small can of black high temperature paint on a workbench with a brush
high temperature paint can

text: Gasto: unos electrodos, discos de corte y la pintura. El resto salió de la basura de otros.

visuals.v: Claudio shrugging with open hands beside the pile of scrap materials, a half smile
welding electrodes and a cutting disc on a workbench

text: Son siete pasos. Uno, el paso que nunca hay que saltearse: purgar la garrafa. Dos, cortar la puerta.

visuals.v: Claudio in front of the scratched blackboard in his workshop where he has drawn a gas cylinder stove, pointing with chalk
a blackboard with a chalk drawing of a horizontal cylinder stove with a chimney, door and legs

text: Tres, las patas. Cuatro, el collar y la chimenea. Cinco, la puerta con bisagras y el regulador de aire.

visuals.v: a blackboard with chalk numbers three and four next to small drawings of legs and a pipe collar
Claudio tapping a blackboard with chalk looking at the camera

text: Seis, el piso de ladrillo y el cenicero. Y siete, pintar, instalar y hacer la primera prueba.

visuals.v: a blackboard with chalk numbers six and seven next to a drawing of a brick floor and a thermometer
Claudio smiling at the camera beside the blackboard

text: Si te gustan estos inventos con chatarra, quédate en el taller, que hay más. Y ahora, lo importante.

visuals.v: Claudio wiping his hands on a rag and facing the camera casually in his workshop
workshop tools on a wall

text: Todo el trabajo me llevó un fin de semana, con las pausas para curar la pintura y para probar.

visuals.v: a stopwatch and a notebook on a workbench with a pencil
Claudio checking his watch near the stove materials, time to start

text: Paso uno. Una garrafa vacía no está vacía: queda gas adentro. Gas que no se ve, y que explota con una chispa.

visuals.v: an old household gas cylinder standing outdoors on dirt in an open yard with no one near it, a wrench resting on top
visuals.motion: the wind moves a few dry leaves on the ground around the cylinder

visuals.v: warning sign for flammable gas
person lifting gas cylinder

text: El gas de las garrafas es más pesado que el aire. No se va para arriba: se junta abajo, en el piso y en los pozos.

visuals.v: gas flame blue
a diagram chalk drawn on a blackboard showing gas heavier than air pooling at the floor of a room beside a cylinder

text: Una garrafa vacía pesa lo que dice la tara. Si pesa de más, todavía tiene gas, y hay que esperar o llevarla a gasificar.

visuals.v: Claudio lifting an old gas cylinder with both hands and feeling its weight, outdoors
a gas cylinder placed on a bathroom scale outdoors on a wooden board

text: Por eso este paso se hace afuera, al aire libre, lejos de la casa, y sin ninguna chispa cerca.

visuals.v: open air field with grass
a wide open yard with grass far from buildings, an old gas cylinder standing on the ground next to a bucket of water and a hose

text: Primero abro la válvula, a fondo, y dejo que salga lo que tenga. Despacio, y sin nadie cerca.

visuals.v: Claudio wearing safety glasses and leather gloves holding a large adjustable wrench on a gas cylinder valve outdoors, serious calm face
close view of a hand wearing a leather glove gripping a wrench on a brass cylinder valve

text: Después, con la llave, saco la válvula entera. Y lleno la garrafa de agua, hasta que rebalse.

visuals.v: a hose filling an old gas cylinder opening with water outdoors, water overflowing onto the dirt
water pouring from a garden hose

text: El agua empuja el gas hacia afuera, y ocupa su lugar. Con la garrafa llena de agua, ya no hay dónde se junte el gas.

visuals.v: water from a garden hose pouring into the open valve hole of an old gas cylinder standing outdoors, the water rising and overflowing
visuals.motion: the water flows continuously and overflows over the edge of the hole

visuals.v: an old gas cylinder full of water standing in a yard with water dripping from the opening

text: Y esto es lo que te pido: nunca, nunca, amoladora ni soldadura sobre una garrafa que no purgaste.

visuals.v: Claudio looking at the camera very seriously beside the water-filled cylinder outdoors, one finger raised
safety goggles and gloves on a workbench

text: Si no sabes si la tuya está bien vacía, no la toques: llévala al lugar donde la cargan, y que te la gasifiquen ellos.

visuals.v: a handwritten cardboard sign on a workbench that has no text, a pair of safety glasses and gloves beside it
Claudio with arms crossed outdoors in his yard, stern expression

text: La dejo así, llena de agua, durante todo el trabajo de corte. El agua es la que me protege.

visuals.v: an old gas cylinder lying outdoors on a pair of wooden blocks, full of water, in a sunny yard
water drops falling

text: Mientras esté llena hasta arriba, no hay gas adentro, no hay mezcla, y no hay chispa que importe. Esa es la lógica.

visuals.v: an old gas cylinder lying on its side filled with water in a yard with a plastic cap on the valve hole
the surface of the water in the open hole of a cylinder reflecting the sky
visuals.motion: a gentle ripple moves across the water surface

text: Paso dos, la puerta. La marco en un extremo de la garrafa, de veinte por quince centímetros.

visuals.v: Claudio marking a rectangle with a paint marker on the side of a horizontal gas cylinder lying on a workbench, wearing safety glasses
a rectangle drawn with paint marker on the curved side of an old gas cylinder

text: Antes de cortar, la trabo con dos tacos de madera y una prensa: una garrafa que rueda mientras cortas es un accidente.

visuals.v: two wooden blocks and clamps holding a gas cylinder steady on a workbench so that it cannot roll
Claudio tightening a clamp that holds a gas cylinder on blocks, looking at it carefully

text: Que no sea muy grande: tiene que entrar la leña, pero no se te tiene que escapar el calor por todos lados.

visuals.v: a metal gas cylinder on two wooden blocks with a paint marker rectangle on its end and a tape measure laid on it
tape measure on metal

text: Amoladora, anteojos y protección de oídos. Corto siguiendo la línea, con la garrafa todavía llena de agua.

visuals.v: a person wearing safety glasses cutting a steel cylinder with an angle grinder, orange sparks flying to the side outdoors
visuals.motion: sparks fly to the right and the cutting disc moves along the marked line

visuals.v: angle grinder cutting steel sparks

text: Las chispas van lejos, y por eso se corta afuera. Dentro del galpón, hasta que haya olor a gas cero.

visuals.v: sparks flying from angle grinder
Claudio cutting steel with an angle grinder on a cylinder, sparks flying, concentrated looking down at the cut

text: Sale la tapa. Por el agujero veo el agua adentro, y ningún olor a gas.

visuals.v: a rectangular door cutout piece of steel lying on the grass next to a gas cylinder, its cut edges bright
the rectangular opening cut into the side of a gas cylinder with bright cut edges and a little steam rising from the water inside
visuals.motion: a little steam rises from the water inside the cylinder

text: Ahora sí, lo vacío. Y lo dejo secar al sol, con la puerta abierta.

visuals.v: a plastic bucket receiving water poured out of a gas cylinder tilted on a wooden block, outdoors
Claudio tilting the cylinder to pour water into a drain, outdoors

text: Lima en los bordes, para que no corten las manos, ni se enganchen en la bisagra.

visuals.v: Claudio filing the cut edges of a steel opening with a flat file, sparks none, looking down at his work
metal file on steel

text: Y paso la mano con guante por todo el borde. Una chapa cortada es una cuchilla.

visuals.v: steel sheet edge deburring
a hand sliding along a freshly filed edge of a steel opening wearing a leather glove

text: Paso tres, las patas. Cuatro planchuelas de cuarenta centímetros, iguales.

visuals.v: three steel flat bars cut to equal length lying in a row on a workbench with a tape measure
cutting steel flat bar

text: Las suelto de a pares, con la garrafa acostada. Primero puntos, y recién después el cordón entero.

visuals.v: Claudio welding a steel leg onto the side of a horizontal gas cylinder wearing a welding helmet, blue arc light, on a workbench
welder welding steel sparks

text: Con nivel, sí o sí: si queda inclinada hacia la puerta, la ceniza se te cae afuera.

visuals.v: a try square held against a welded steel leg on the side of a cylinder, the gap visible
a small spirit level placed on top of a horizontal gas cylinder on a workbench with its bubble moving to the center
visuals.motion: the bubble in the level slowly slides to the centre

text: La sacudo con la mano: no tiene que bailar. Si baila, le pongo una chapita debajo de la pata que cojea.

visuals.v: Claudio shaking the stove by its upper edge to test its stability on four legs on the concrete floor
a gas cylinder on four steel legs standing on a concrete floor with a thin shim under one leg

text: Y listo: la garrafa parada en cuatro patas, a la altura justa para cargar la leña sin agacharse.

visuals.v: welder wearing protective helmet
a gas cylinder standing on four steel legs on a concrete workshop floor, freshly welded, seen from the front

text: Paso cuatro, la chimenea. Marco un círculo del diámetro del caño, al fondo de la garrafa, del lado de atrás.

visuals.v: Claudio tracing a circle with a marker on the top of the gas cylinder using a short piece of chimney pipe as a template, his face concentrated
a four inch steel pipe placed on top of a gas cylinder back end with a marker circle drawn around its base

text: Corto el agujero con la amoladora, y le suelto un collar corto de caño para que el humo salga hacia arriba.

visuals.v: the back end of a horizontal gas cylinder with a drilled circular opening cut and a short steel collar tube welded around the hole
an angle grinder cutting a circular opening on top of a cylinder, orange sparks fly
visuals.motion: sparks fly and the disc moves along the circle

text: La soldadura tiene que cerrar todo el contorno: si queda un hueco, el humo se te mete en el galpón.

visuals.v: welding sparks close up
Claudio welding a short steel collar onto the top rear of a gas cylinder, helmet on, blue arc

text: Después, el caño sube un tramo, y hace un codo para salir por la pared.

visuals.v: a steel chimney pipe with an elbow connected to the collar of a black gas cylinder stove on a workbench
stove pipe elbow

text: Atención acá: la chimenea tiene que salir afuera. Todo el humo de la leña se va por ahí.

visuals.v: Claudio explaining with both hands showing the path of smoke going up and out through a wall, in his workshop
a diagram drawn with chalk on a blackboard showing a stove, a chimney going up and out through the wall to the outside

text: ¿Por qué tira una chimenea? Porque el aire caliente sube, y al subir arrastra aire fresco por la puerta. Cuanto más alta, más fuerte.

visuals.v: hot air rising above a flame
a blackboard drawing showing warm smoke rising in a tall chimney pulling air in through a lower door of a stove

text: El diámetro: cuatro pulgadas me alcanzó para esta garrafa. Más grande, enfría el humo y tira peor.

visuals.v: a four inch and a six inch steel chimney pipe side by side on a workbench
Claudio measuring the diameter of a chimney pipe with a caliper

text: Paso cinco. La puerta que corté, la vuelvo a poner con dos bisagras soldadas del lado de arriba.

visuals.v: the rectangular door cut out of the gas cylinder laid flat on a workbench with two hinges placed along one edge
door hinge welding

text: Que la puerta abra hacia abajo o hacia el costado, pero que cierre ajustada.

visuals.v: welding a hinge onto a steel stove door lying on a workbench, bright blue arc and smoke
visuals.motion: a bright arc flickers and smoke rises slowly

visuals.v: Claudio welding with a helmet at a workbench, the stove door in front of him

text: Un pestillo de planchuela, y abajo una ranura con una chapita deslizante: es el regulador de aire.

visuals.v: a small steel latch welded on the edge of a stove door, an adjustable draft slot cut in the lower part of the door
stove door latch

text: Con la chapita abierta, el fuego se aviva. Cerrada, se apaga despacio. Así regulas el calor.

visuals.v: Claudio showing with his finger the sliding air regulator plate on the stove door, looking at the camera
close view of a sliding steel plate over a slot in a stove door, workbench

text: Abierta del todo, la leña arde fuerte y rápido. Cerrada a medias, dura horas y calienta parejo. Es la mejor parte del diseño.

visuals.v: a fire inside a stove growing brighter as the air regulator slot is opened
visuals.motion: the flames grow stronger and lean toward the slot

visuals.v: stove air control
a stove air regulator slot with a small sliding plate half open and an orange glow inside

text: Cuatro, el cenicero: una bandeja de chapa que desliza debajo, para sacar la ceniza sin apagar el fuego. Que lo pedían en los comentarios.

visuals.v: a heavy sheet of steel being cut into a rectangle on a workbench, a steel ash tray shape drawn on it
steel sheet cutting

text: Paso seis. Dentro, en el piso, una cama de ladrillos refractarios, de canto, apretados uno contra otro.

visuals.v: red fire bricks being placed one by one on the steel floor of a horizontal gas cylinder stove through its door
visuals.motion: a hand places a brick and presses it down gently

visuals.v: Claudio kneeling and placing fire bricks inside the stove through the open door, looking in

text: Protegen la chapa del calor directo, y guardan calor cuando el fuego baja.

visuals.v: the inside of a gas cylinder stove with a floor of fire bricks laid in rows and a small gap at the bottom for air
fire bricks in a fireplace

text: Sin cemento ni mezcla: los ladrillos van sueltos, así se mueven con la dilatación y no se rajan.

visuals.v: gloved hands arranging a loose row of fire bricks on the floor of a stove, leaving small gaps
fire bricks stacked

text: Y ojo con el fondo: sin agujeros, como decían los comentarios. El aire entra por la puerta y por la ranura, y nada más.

visuals.v: Claudio looking through the stove door at the bricks with a flashlight, serious and calm
close view of the interior of a black gas cylinder stove with bricks and welded tabs

text: La ceniza cae por la rejilla del frente al cenicero, que se saca por abajo. Y el fondo de la garrafa queda entero.

visuals.v: ash falling from a fireplace
a steel ash tray sliding under a stove, the tray catching a little ash

text: Quedó una estufa. Todavía sin pintar. Y quise probarla en el patio, antes de meterla al galpón.

visuals.v: Claudio standing outdoors in the yard beside the finished unpainted gas cylinder stove on its four legs with its chimney pipe pointing up, arms crossed, proud look
a bare steel stove made from a gas cylinder with legs and a chimney pipe standing on a concrete patio in daylight

text: Papel, ramitas finas, y la puerta entreabierta. Y al principio, humo. Un humo blanco, de aceite viejo y pintura vieja que se quema.

visuals.v: a small fire of newspaper and dry sticks burning inside the open door of a bare steel gas cylinder stove outdoors
visuals.motion: the small flames flicker and thin smoke rises from the chimney

visuals.v: smoke rising from a metal chimney
smoke from a chimney outdoors

text: Pero había otro problema: el humo no subía por la chimenea. Se me salía por la puerta.

visuals.v: thick grey smoke coming out of the stove door into a yard instead of going up the chimney, with a small flame inside
Claudio waving smoke away from his face next to the stove, coughing a little, eyes squinting

text: La estufa no tiraba. Lo pensé un rato, y no era la estufa: era la chimenea.

visuals.v: smoke from a campfire
Claudio crouching to look into the stove door at the fire, frowning

text: Era muy corta. Una chimenea corta no tira, porque el tiro depende de la altura.

visuals.v: a very short stove pipe about forty centimetres tall on top of a gas cylinder stove outdoors, smoke hesitating
chimney pipe on a roof

text: Le agregué dos tramos más, hasta casi tres metros. Y ahí sí: el humo subió derecho, y la estufa empezó a rugir.

visuals.v: a taller chimney pipe made of three sections connected to a gas cylinder stove outdoors, smoke rising straight up
smoke rising straight out of a tall chimney pipe on a gas cylinder stove outdoors
visuals.motion: the smoke climbs steadily upward

text: Ese fue el error: una chimenea de poca altura. Con tres metros, tira como una locomotora.

visuals.v: Claudio smiling widely beside the stove with its roaring fire visible through the door, orange light on his face
a bright orange fire roaring inside a gas cylinder stove, seen through the open door

text: Y esto aplica a cualquier chimenea: si no tira, antes de tocar la estufa, mide la altura. Casi siempre es eso.

visuals.v: steam locomotive smoke
Claudio looking up at the chimney outdoors with smoke rising straight, hands on hips, satisfied

text: Paso siete. Pintura negra para altas temperaturas, dos manos finas. Y sobre una chapa limpia, sin óxido.

visuals.v: Claudio brushing black high temperature paint on a gas cylinder stove on its legs in his yard, concentrated
a gas cylinder stove half painted in matt black with a wide brush and an open paint can beside it

text: Primero lijo y paso el cepillo de alambre. La pintura sobre óxido se despega al primer calor.

visuals.v: a steel wire brush cleaning rust from a gas cylinder stove surface, rust dust
wire brush cleaning rust

text: Y la dejo secar un día entero, antes del primer fuego de verdad.

visuals.v: black paint being brushed over bare steel on a stove, thin even coat
visuals.motion: the brush moves slowly along the metal leaving a black coat

visuals.v: painting steel black

text: La pintura de alta temperatura se cura con calor: la primera vez que prendes, huele y larga humo.

visuals.v: Claudio looking at the sky and then at the painted stove drying in the sun in his yard
sun drying paint

text: Por eso el primer encendido es chico, tres veces, con todo abierto, hasta que no huela más.

visuals.v: a workshop with its sliding door and window wide open and a stove burning a small fire with faint smoke
Claudio opening a window of the workshop while the new stove burns a small fire

text: Y así queda: una salamandra negra, con una manija de varilla roja en la puerta.

visuals.v: Claudio showing the painted black stove to the camera, hand resting on its top, proud
a finished matt black stove made from a gas cylinder with a chimney pipe and a neat red handle on the door, in a workshop

text: La llevamos al galpón, sobre un piso que no se prende fuego: cemento, y debajo una chapa más.

visuals.v: Claudio and a neighbour carrying the black stove into the workshop on a wooden pallet
a black stove made from a gas cylinder placed on a concrete workshop floor on a layer of bricks near a wall

text: Y debajo de la estufa, una chapa más, por si cae una brasa. Una brasa en un piso de madera es un incendio.

visuals.v: fireproof floor tile
a steel plate under a stove on a concrete floor, bricks around it in a workshop

text: Distancia: al menos un metro de cualquier cosa que se queme. Madera, trapos, nafta, pintura.

visuals.v: a measuring tape showing one metre between a stove and a wooden shelf in a workshop
tape measure

text: La chimenea sale por la pared de chapa con un manguito de metal alrededor, para que no caliente la madera.

visuals.v: a stove chimney pipe passing through a hole in the sheet metal wall of a workshop shed with a metal sleeve around it
visuals.motion: a faint wisp of steam rises from the metal collar

visuals.v: Claudio fitting a metal sleeve around the chimney pipe at the wall of his shed with a screwdriver

text: Afuera, un sombrerito antilluvia, y por encima de la cumbrera del techo, para que no se te vuelque el humo.

visuals.v: a chimney pipe with a rain cap at the top outside a shed roof, blue sky behind
chimney cap on roof

text: Y esto, que no es opcional: un detector de monóxido de carbono. El monóxido no se ve ni se huele.

visuals.v: Claudio fixing a carbon monoxide detector on the workshop wall with a drill and a screw, looking up at it
a small white carbon monoxide detector mounted on a shed wall with a green light on

text: Lo pruebo con el botón, y lo cambio cuando se cumple la fecha de vencimiento. Un detector vencido no detecta.

visuals.v: a smoke detector and a carbon monoxide detector installed side by side on a workshop wall
Claudio pressing the test button on the carbon monoxide detector, the light blinking

text: Nada de usar esto en un ambiente cerrado sin tiraje, y menos en un dormitorio. Esto es para un galpón ventilado.

visuals.v: carbon monoxide detector device
Claudio standing in front of the stove pointing to the detector on the wall and then to the chimney, looking at the camera

text: Primera prueba de verdad. Ramitas secas, un poco de papel, y la puerta entreabierta para que agarre.

visuals.v: Claudio crouching to light dry sticks inside the black stove in his workshop with a long match, frost on the window behind him
a long match being lit and held to a pile of dry sticks and paper inside a stove
visuals.motion: the match flame touches the paper and the paper starts to burn

text: El termómetro marca nueve grados. Y la leña, de eucalipto bien seco, y sin tratar. Nada de maderas pintadas ni laminadas.

visuals.v: a wall thermometer in a workshop showing nine degrees, frost visible on the window beside it
frozen window in winter

text: Agrego dos troncos, cierro la puerta casi del todo, y espero.

visuals.v: logs being added to a burning stove through the open door, flames growing
visuals.motion: the flames grow and flicker around the logs

visuals.v: a pile of dry eucalyptus logs next to the stove on a bit of sheet metal

text: A los diez minutos ya se siente el calor en la cara. A los veinte, hay que sacarse la campera.

visuals.v: wood burning in a stove with orange flames
Claudio sitting on an upturned bucket next to the stove with a mug, warming his hands, content face

text: Dieciséis grados, y la escarcha del vidrio empieza a correrse. A los cuarenta minutos, veinte.

visuals.v: a round thermometer in a workshop showing sixteen degrees with a little condensation on the glass
the window of a workshop with frost melting and dripping water down the glass
visuals.motion: drops slide down the glass

text: Un galpón que amanecía a seis, en una hora estaba como una cocina.

visuals.v: Claudio laughing with his jacket off beside the stove, sleeves rolled up, visibly warm
warm orange light from a stove in a dark room

text: Y ese calor se queda: la chapa y los ladrillos guardan temperatura, y el galpón no se enfría de golpe cuando se apaga el fuego.

visuals.v: cozy warm room from a fire
Claudio leaning on his workbench near the stove, relaxed and warm, working with a pencil

text: Ahora la comparación honesta. Un día prendí la estufa eléctrica de dos barras. Otro día, la salamandra.

visuals.v: a workshop with an electric two-bar heater on one side and a black gas cylinder stove on the other, a thermometer on a stool in the middle
Claudio setting a notebook and two thermometers on a bench, preparing a test

text: Misma habitación, mismo termómetro, y mismo horario. Arrancando los dos días cerca de los diez grados.

visuals.v: a workshop clock on a wall showing a time with a thermometer next to it
wall clock

text: Con la estufa eléctrica, después de una hora, subió unos tres grados. Con la salamandra, subió más de diez.

visuals.v: a notebook open with a hand-drawn table with two columns, numbers written in pencil, a pencil resting on it
Claudio writing the numbers in the notebook with a pencil, looking down

text: Pero ojo, que no es una comparación justa en todo. La estufa se enchufa y listo. La salamandra pide leña, ceniza y atención.

visuals.v: Claudio shrugging honestly with open hands in his workshop
the electric heater and the black stove side by side on the concrete floor, both off

text: Por el lado del costo, la leña me sale casi gratis, porque la junto de podas. La luz, en cambio, es una factura.

visuals.v: an electric bill and a pile of firewood side by side on a workbench with a calculator
Claudio weighing options with his hands like a balance, looking at the camera

text: Hay que cortar leña, cargarla cada tanto, y vaciar la ceniza. Es otro oficio. Pero el calor es otro mundo.

visuals.v: firewood stacked
Claudio carrying an armful of firewood toward the stove, steam from his breath

text: La ceniza se saca con el cenicero, con la estufa apagada y fría, y se guarda en un balde metálico. Nunca en plástico.

visuals.v: the stove door open showing glowing coals and a small ash tray pulled halfway out beneath
an ash tray being slid out under a stove, grey ash and red embers
visuals.motion: a gentle puff of ash rises

visuals.v: a pair of leather gloves resting on a metal bucket beside a stove

text: Y mientras haya brasas, la estufa no se deja sola. Ni se va uno a dormir con fuego dentro de casa.

visuals.v: a metal bucket with a lid holding grey ash beside a stove on a concrete floor
metal ash bucket

text: Una vez por temporada, y con frecuencia si usas leña húmeda, limpio la chimenea. El hollín se acumula, y eso es lo que se prende fuego.

visuals.v: Claudio sweeping the chimney with a long brush at the end of a rod, standing on a stool outdoors
chimney sweep brush

text: Ahora, lo que la gente pedía en los comentarios. Primero, la inclinación.

visuals.v: Claudio looking at the camera with a pencil, notebook in hand, explaining
person writing in notebook

text: Si tiltas la boca de carga hacia abajo, la leña se desliza sola a medida que se quema. Esto lo pedían con más fuerza.

visuals.v: a drawing on a blackboard of a stove with a loading tube tilted downward toward the fire so that logs slide in by gravity
wood logs sliding

text: En mi versión, por simpleza, la puerta es horizontal, y cargo a mano. Pero si haces otra, inclínala.

visuals.v: Claudio shaking his head with a half smile, pointing at the stove door
the black stove with a small hopper added above the door, drawn in chalk on the wall

text: También puedes hacerla vertical, parada. Es más chica en el piso, pero la leña tiene que ser más corta.

visuals.v: a vertical gas cylinder stove with a small door at the bottom and a chimney on top compared with a horizontal one on a blackboard drawing
Claudio comparing two sketches of stoves with a pencil, thinking

text: Dos, la madera. Tratada, pintada, laminada o aglomerado: no. Al quemarse suelta químicos que te enferman.

visuals.v: burning treated wood hazard
Claudio showing a piece of painted plywood and a piece of clean eucalyptus, shaking his head at the painted one

text: Leña seca, de monte, y nada más. Y la leña verde, no: humea, ensucia la chimenea y calienta poco.

visuals.v: a pile of clean dry eucalyptus firewood on the left and a pile of painted plywood scraps with a red cross drawn on the right
dry firewood logs

text: Y limpia la chimenea cada tanto. El hollín se acumula, y con el tiempo se puede prender fuego.

visuals.v: Claudio cleaning the inside of the chimney pipe with a wire brush on a long handle, soot on his gloves
soot black creosote inside a steel chimney pipe cross section

text: En total: un fin de semana, unos electrodos, discos y pintura. Y un galpón que dejó de ser un freezer.

visuals.v: Claudio looking proudly at the finished stove in his workshop, tools resting on the bench
a clean tidy workshop with the black stove glowing in the corner and tools arranged on a pegboard

text: Y encima, una sorpresa: la tapa de la salamandra es una cocina. Pongo una olla y hierve en diez minutos.

visuals.v: Claudio placing a steel pot on top of the black stove, steam rising from the pot, in his workshop
a pot of water steaming on top of a black stove, small bubbles rising
visuals.motion: steam rises steadily from the pot and the water bubbles gently

text: Un guiso en el taller, mientras trabajo. Con la misma leña que me calienta.

visuals.v: a pot of stew steaming on top of the black stove in a workshop, two plates on a bench beside it
cooking pot on a wood stove

text: El mismo fuego que calienta el galpón, me da el almuerzo. Y con una garrafa que estaba tirada.

visuals.v: Claudio eating a hot meal at his workbench next to the stove, relaxed, looking toward the camera
a plate of stew and bread on a wooden workbench near the glowing stove

text: Y un matafuego al alcance, siempre. Una estufa a leña es un fuego dentro de tu casa.

visuals.v: Claudio placing a metal bucket on the floor beside the stove and a fire extinguisher on the wall nearby
a red fire extinguisher mounted on a shed wall near a black stove

text: El resumen de seguridad. Uno, purgar la garrafa con agua, afuera, siempre. Dos, chimenea alta y hacia el exterior.

visuals.v: Claudio standing beside the stove counting on his fingers, serious but warm
a blackboard with a list of four safety points drawn with chalk next to the stove

text: Tres, detector de monóxido y matafuego. Cuatro, un metro de distancia de lo que se quema, y nada de dormitorios.

visuals.v: a carbon monoxide detector and a fire extinguisher beside a stove on a shed wall
Claudio pointing to the detector and the extinguisher with a smile

text: Si tienes una garrafa vieja, no la tires: pero tampoco la cortes sin purgarla. Cuéntame qué harías tú con ella.

visuals.v: Claudio looking into the camera with the stove glowing behind him, a friendly half smile
cozy workshop with a warm fire

text: En el próximo video, una prensa plegadora para doblar chapa de tres milímetros. Nos vemos en el taller.

visuals.v: the door of the black stove glowing orange in a dark workshop at night, sparks flying
visuals.motion: the fire flickers and a spark rises

visuals.v: Claudio waving goodbye to the camera next to the stove, warm light on his face
